title: Uefa fines FA and FAI after England and Republic of Ireland fans boo anthems - BBC Sport
text: Uefa has fined the Football Association and the Football Association of Ireland after the national anthems were booed before the Republic of Ireland played England in the Nations League in September.

title: Islington: Murder probe after boy found stabbed in bike crash - BBC News
text: Deonte Mowatt-Slater was found with a suspected stab wound after he crashed on Courtauld Road, on the corner of Beachcroft Way A murder investigation has been opened after a 16-year-old boy was found fatally injured in north London.
translations_zh: 德翁特·莫瓦特-斯莱特 (Deonte Mowatt-Slater) 在考陶尔德路 (Courtauld Road) 与比奇克罗夫特路 (Beachcroft Way) 拐角处发生车祸，被发现身上疑似有刀伤。一名 16 岁男孩在伦敦北部被发现受重伤后，警方展开了谋杀案调查。

title: Jeffrey Donaldson: Case 'on track' with next stage in July  - BBC News
text: The prosecution case against former Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) leader Sir Jeffrey Donaldson on historical sex offence charges is progressing “on track”, a review hearing in Newry has heard.

title: Shotton: Arrest after hit-and-run leaves child in hospital - BBC News
text: The child was hit by a motorbike on Central Drive in Shotton, Flintshire A man has been arrested after a child was airlifted to hospital with life-changing injuries following a hit-and-run.

title: Man, 92, to go on trial for historic Bristol rape and murder case - BBC News
text: Man, 92, to go on trial for 1967 rape and murder case Ryland Headley appeared via video link at Bristol Magistrates' Court on Wednesday A 92-year-old man will go on trial next year after being charged with the rape and murder of an elderly woman 57 years ago.

title: King postpones public duties as cancer treatment begins - BBC News
text: King will be disappointed he can't be out meeting people - former adviser More now from the King's former communications secretary JulianPayne, who said the Palace will have prepared for a situation like this.

国王会因为无法外出与民众见面而感到失望——国王的前通讯大臣兼前顾问朱利安·佩恩表示，王室将为这种可能性做好准备。

title: Ex-Post Office boss sorry for 'brilliant news' prosecution email - BBC News
text: The former subpostmistress, Seema Misra, who was jailed for 15 months over the Horizon IT, has rejected an apology from a former Post Office boss who at the time of her conviction called it "brilliant news".

title: Rashee Rice: Arrest warrant issued for Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver over crash - BBC Sport
text: An arrest warrant has been issued for Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice after he was involved a hit-and-run crash that injured four people.

title: Barry crash leaves two women dead and one man critical  - BBC News
text: Two women die and one man critical after crash The crash happed on the A4050 in Barry, Vale of Glamorgan, near Pugh’s Garden Centre Two women have died and two men have been taken to hospital, one in a critical condition, after a crash.

title: Lancaster: Boy, 11, died trying social media craze - family - BBC News
text: Tommie-lee Gracie Billington was found at a house on Greenset Close in Lancaster The family of an 11-year-old boy who died after apparently taking part in a dangerous social media craze say they are "devastated".

text: A shoplifting bird dubbed "Steven Seagull" has been banned from a convenience store for flying off with packets of crisps over a six-year stealing spree.

title: Newham: Residents warned after gas bottle explodes in bin lorry - BBC News
text: An east London council is urging residents to dispose of hazardous waste properly after an empty gas bottle thrown in a household bin exploded in a refuse lorry, injuring a worker.
